title: NNSA enterprise-baseline hold: portfolio governance closures do not close the plutonium recommendation
summary: GAO-24-106342 closes four portfolio-governance recommendations, but GAO-23-104661 still records the plutonium-modernization lifecycle-cost recommendation open and the complete enterprise baseline remains unpublished. Denominator: The complete plutonium-modernization program across production and support sites, evaluated against the exact GAO-23-104661 integrated-schedule and lifecycle-cost recommendation.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Recurring output and baseline hold.
